payload.title: Riemann hypothesis finite checker input and historical log archive
payload.body:
# Riemann hypothesis finite checker input and historical log archive

25 exact original files, including 16 code sources. This artifact-check REVIEW preserves source/input provenance and records the precise reproduction boundaries around the existing indexed RESULT. It is inconclusive about mathematical validity; no research code was executed.

Finite anchor/Q-core, product-fibre, identity/window, conditional Lambda, K1/A2 and J source families are archived. Q import lookup needs PYTHONPATH=computations; the real q_value module is present. Finite Q tails remain open. Product/window diagnostics use floating point. Lambda physical_Q is undefined; its seven-row old output differs from the four default T values and records no quad/complete invocation. J old log T_MAX41 differs from source default50. Local numerical logs are historical reported claims, not a fresh RH/Gram/cancellation certification.

Raw code, fixtures, checksum-bound specifications, JSON prefixes/tails and expected records are preserved without banners or reformatting. Scientific and licence declarations live in sidecars. A file named certificate, a stored PASS or a published algorithm is not new independent proof acceptance.

Li Hongmin is the authorized human contributor; original drafting/checking was AI-assisted, with source-model identity not independently reconstructed. Codex performed static archival review and packaging. Own code Apache-2.0; original text/data CC BY 4.0; cited third-party passages retain source rights.
